question: Harmanpreet Singh has been awarded the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2024. He is associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harmanpreet Singh** is an acclaimed Indian professional field hockey player and serves as the captain of the Indian men's hockey team.
 
• He plays as a **defender** and is also renowned for his expertise in drag flicking, which is a critical skill in penalty corners.
 
• Harmanpreet Singh has been instrumental in India’s success in **international hockey tournaments**, including the team’s bronze medal victory at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** is India’s highest sporting honor, and Harmanpreet Singh was awarded this in 2024 in recognition of his outstanding contributions to the sport of hockey.
 
• Under his leadership, the Indian hockey team has achieved remarkable milestones, including podium finishes at the **Asian Games** and the **FIH Hockey Pro League**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• It is the **highest sporting honor in India**, awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• Named after **Major Dhyan Chand**, one of the greatest hockey players in history, the award recognizes exceptional performance in sports.
 
• The award includes a **medal, a certificate, and a cash prize**.
 
 
 
• **Hockey in India:**
 
 
• Hockey is often regarded as India’s **national sport**, with a rich history of achievements, including **8 Olympic gold medals**.
 
• The Indian men’s hockey team won its last Olympic gold medal in **1980 at the Moscow Games**.
 
• The sport has seen a revival in recent years, with improved performances in global tournaments like the **Hockey World Cup** and the **FIH Pro League**.
 
 
 
• **Harmanpreet Singh’s Achievements:**
 
 
• He was the **top scorer** for India in several international tournaments.
 
• Harmanpreet has won accolades such as the **FIH Rising Star of the Year** and was named in the **FIH All-Star Team**.
 
• He is celebrated for his leadership and ability to deliver under pressure during high-stakes matches.
 
 
 
• **Role of Drag Flicking in Hockey:**
 
 
• Drag flicking is a **specialized skill** used to score goals from penalty corners.
 
• It requires a combination of **strength, technique, and precision**.
 
• Harmanpreet Singh is one of the **world’s finest drag flickers**, making him a crucial asset to the Indian team.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Tokyo Olympics 2020:**

 
 
• The Indian men’s hockey team won a **bronze medal**, ending a 41-year medal drought at the Olympics.
 
• Harmanpreet Singh played a crucial role in this historic achievement by scoring key goals.
 
 
 
• **Asian Games:**
 
 
• The Indian hockey team, under Harmanpreet’s leadership, has consistently performed well in the **Asian Games**, securing podium finishes.
 
• Harmanpreet’s ability to lead from the front has been pivotal in maintaining India’s dominance in the Asian circuit.
